"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Republicans do not want to create new trading blocs to battle rivals.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Republicans intend to encourage general political and economic reform, starting with the American neighborhood.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Fidel Castro continues to impose communist economic controls and absolute political repression of 11 million Cubans.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Cuban regime harasses and jails dissidents.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Cuban regime restricts economic activity.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Cuban regime forces Cubans into the sea in a desperate bid for freedom.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Cuban regime gives refuge to fugitives from American justice.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Cuban regime hosts a sophisticated Russian espionage facility that intercepts U.S. government and private communications.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Cuban regime ordered its air force to shoot down two unarmed U.S. civilian airplanes, thereby killing American citizens.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"U.S. policy toward Cuba should be based upon sound, clear principles.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"U.S. economic and political relations with Cuba will change when the Cuban regime frees all prisoners of conscience.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"U.S. economic and political relations with Cuba will change when the Cuban regime legalizes peaceful protest.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"U.S. economic and political relations with Cuba will change when the Cuban regime allows opposition political activity.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"U.S. economic and political relations with Cuba will change when the Cuban regime permits free expression.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"U.S. economic and political relations with Cuba will change when the Cuban regime commits to democratic elections.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"This policy will be strengthened by active American support for Cuban dissidents.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Republicans will not support any subsidy of Castro's Cuba.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Republicans will not support any subsidy of any other terrorist state.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
